title: 은행 창구에서 통장 만들기
objective: Learners can use 10 key words for opening a bank account at a Korean bank counter (번호표, 창구, 계좌, 통장, 개설하다, 신분증, 외국인등록증, 비밀번호, 서명하다, 체크카드) in short sentences. They will use them to take a number and wait, say why they came ('통장 만들러 왔어요'), hand over their ID, and answer the teller's requests to enter a PIN or sign.
summary: Ten key words for opening a bank account at a Korean bank counter, from taking a number ticket to signing the form and getting a debit card.

task.title: COMPLETE THE BANK CONVERSATIONS
task.line: Choose the right word in each pair, or fill in each blank with a word from this worksheet in the right form.

words.exampleMeaning: Take a number ticket first and wait.
There are a lot of people in front of the teller windows.
I need an account for my salary to go into.

words.meaning: bankbook (the paper book for your account)

words.example: 계좌 개설하는 데 시간이 좀 걸려요.
words.exampleMeaning: Opening an account takes a little while.
I left my ID at home.

words.meaning: residence card (ID card for foreign residents)
words.exampleMeaning: I carry my residence card in my wallet.
Read it carefully before you sign.
Would you like a debit card as well?

exercises: Choose the right words: 제 (번호표 / 비밀번호)는 27번이에요. 아, "27번 손님, 5번 (창구 / 계좌)로 오세요."
Choose the right words: 손님: 안녕하세요. (통장 / 번호표) 만들러 왔어요. 외국인도 (계좌 / 창구)를 개설할 수 있어요?
Fill in the blank with the right form of 개설하다: 직원: 오늘 어떤 업무 보시겠어요? / 손님: 계좌를 ____러 왔어요.
Choose the right words: 직원: (신분증 / 번호표) 좀 보여 주시겠어요? / 손님: 네, 여기 제 (외국인등록증 / 체크카드)이에요.
Fill in the blanks with 비밀번호 and the right form of 서명하다: 직원: 여기에 ____를 눌러 주세요. 그리고 이름 옆에 ____ 주세요.
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet: 직원: 카드도 필요하세요? / 손님: 네, ____도 만들어 주세요.
